agent_notes: Both supplied NIRF 2025 government ranking pages list the exact institution name and Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.

Normal TLS verification produced the managed proxy error 'self signed certificate in certificate chain'; curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests to expected official and search hostnames.

The official 30 January 2025 IIQA catalogue names 123 programmes and was used for the course records. The official syllabus page separately exposes a Certificate Syllabus category, while the older official 2022 programme-details PDF names certificate courses but does not establish their current active status. A complete current certificate inventory could therefore not be reconciled, so manual_review is required.
Duration and eligibility were left null because the central official catalogue did not explicitly state them.
